reviewer: Source-grounded author review, independent of candidate outputs but not a blind or external assessor.
commonRequiredQualifications: Static source evidence; deployment coherence is unknown and current applicability is unchecked.
A candidate link, matching topic or repeated derived clue is not proof of runtime wiring or delivery.
Each factual clause needs the original passages that support it; native identities and engineer notes are not source citations.
commonForbiddenClaims: A proven incident cause, guaranteed delivery, exactly-once processing or successful physical firing.
Complete system comprehension, exhaustive repository routing or absence beyond the examined supported scope.
Automatic propagation between differently named HTTP headers, concrete database binding or deployed version compatibility.
Independent corroboration from legacy and native projections of the same source.
